A1.justification: Both PDFs describe RepoGenesis and provide readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and appendices A–Q. Content can be matched reliably across the minor layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of coding agents and commercial IDEs, GenesisAgent-8B fine-tuning results, and supplementary empirical analyses in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark evaluations, fine-tuning outcomes, and appendix analyses, including the results in Tables 4–8 and Appendix K.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction and review-rebuttal procedure remain unchanged. GenesisAgent retains the same Python dependency-analysis procedure, Java framework detection, execution verification, and fine-tuning approach described in Section 5.2 and Appendix E.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 106 repositories, comprising 76 training and 30 verified evaluation repositories, covering Python and Java across 18 domains and 11 frameworks. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: DeepCode, MS-Agent, MetaGPT, Qwen-Agent, Antigravity, Cursor, and Copilot retain the same experiment-specific model pairings. The extended comparisons in Appendix K and the GenesisAgent comparison in Table 8 also have unchanged membership.

E3.justification: The data split, evaluation metrics, prompts, model configurations, testing procedures, and fine-tuning budget remain unchanged. Both specify three fine-tuning epochs with learning rate 2e-4 and retain the experimental settings in Appendices D, H, and I.

E4.justification: The difficulty and language breakdowns, framework deployability analysis in Appendix G, and success/failure case studies in Appendix J are unchanged. Figure 3 retains the same Cursor failure trajectory.

E5.justification: Both report averages over five independent runs in Section 4.2 and the same Pass@k estimation procedure in Appendix D.4.1. Agreement statistics and significance reporting in Section 3.3 are also unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Copilot with Claude retains 23.67% Python and 21.45% Java Pass@1 in Table 4; GenesisAgent-8B retains 4.38% and 1.69%, respectively, in Table 8.

T1.justification: The formal task definition in Appendix B, metric formulas in Equations 1–3, and difficulty-scoring definition in Equation 4 and Appendix F.2 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: Both retain the same benchmark novelty claim, review-rebuttal quality-assurance contribution, findings about limited functional correctness, and claim that fine-tuned GenesisAgent-8B achieves performance comparable to GPT-5 mini.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the API-coverage/deployability gap, language and framework differences, and Cursor failure behavior remain unchanged. Both retain the training-set quality uncertainty and limitations concerning microservice scope, language coverage, idealized requirements, and maintainability.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the advertised benchmark location from GitHub's pzy2000/RepoGenesis to microsoft/DKI_LLM/tree/main/RepoGenesis. Implementation details, prompts, hardware, hyperparameters, and the MIT-license disclosure remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish a change in actual resource availability.

R1.justification: Section 6, Table 1, and the reference list retain the same cited works and research positioning. The relationship to function-level, class-level, and repository-level generation benchmarks is unchanged.

P1.justification: The author block updates Zhiyuan Peng's affiliation from Microsoft to Shanghai Jiao Tong University, revises affiliation numbering, and changes contact information. The scientific prose and section organization remain substantively unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 adds agent/model logos to several main-text and appendix results tables, including Tables 4–6 and 16–18, and adjusts their sizing and spacing. Adjacent text reflows across columns and pages, while the figures, table contents, and overall organization are retained.

improvement.justification: The scientific contribution, experimental evidence, explanations, and limitations remain unchanged, including the appendices. Updated author information, a revised repository address, and cosmetic table changes do not materially alter the paper's rigor, clarity, or completeness. Improved resource access is not established by the supplied PDFs.
